issue_request: FHIR-12275 was Published/Persuasive for the Account resource and asked that the Account textual description, which mentioned tracking charges, also refer to payments and adjustments.
initial_application: The historical application appears to have been folded into GF/FHIR-14725. Commit 7a5c52fd1c added Account Scope and Usage narrative that says charges, payments, and adjustments are applied to an Account, and the linked PA Zulip thread explicitly said that GF#14725 should include the proposed change in GF#12275. That application did not update the active StructureDefinition root description, definition, or short summary, which still only described tracking charges.
additional_context: Account is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/account/structuredefinition-Account.xml feeds the current build. FHIR-14725 is already represented on the combined branch by audit commit 9d276e21c99bf9bbc17e092fced0990bbecec381, so it was not separately decided here. No direct Zulip or Confluence record for FHIR-12275 was found that conflicts with the Jira/source conclusion.
